For each local named neighborhood type, independent separated windows and primitive P² imply exponentially likely saturation. Effective Hanf locality in the *named bounded-degree unary-predicate language* reduces each FO truth value to the two endpoint words. This is essential because E in the anonymous language itself has unbounded degree; E-sentences are first translated to named predicates. Joint S3 action on two proper endpoint words length L≥2 is free, forcing numerator multiples of six; every orbit is definable by endpoint equality patterns, yielding the claimed two complete spectra. Proper ternary cycles have no endpoints and satisfy a zero-one law; binary paths parity refutes convergence. Independent exact 3-color endpoint and orbit enumeration for L≤4 corroborates the finite group arithmetic.
